purpose: This table cleans the bronze hourly weather observations captured at the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for downstream flight-delay and operations analyses that join on airport and hour.
usage: Consumers should treat (origin, time_hour) as the row grain and join flight or airport datasets on those columns; wind_gust and pressure carry substantial nulls (74.6% and 11.5% respectively) and must be null-checked before aggregation, and wind_dir and wind_speed carry small null rates (1.68% and 0.015%) that should also be handled explicitly.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped and carry no recoverable business signal; wind_gust remains 74.6% null and pressure 11.5% null with no imputation applied, so analyses sensitive to these fields must account for missingness; year is retained despite being constant at 2013 across all rows.
